name: Maximum-current monitoring relay
summary: A maximum-current relay changes its output when the measured current meets a configured high-current condition.
description: A maximum-current relay changes its output when the measured current meets a configured high-current condition. Its schematic separates measurement, auxiliary power and relay outputs.
